description: User account for the Platypus Health demo tenant on the aucore node. Create with: python scripts/manage_smart_users.py --bulk --users-file module-config/platypus-users.json --node aucore
notes: The password is NOT stored here. This account already exists on aucore (pid 1602); the script is idempotent and will skip it rather than reset the password. The live password is held in AWS Secrets Manager under smilecdr-user-passwords, key smilecdr-platypus-demo-patient-password, alongside the admin and devtester passwords. It is not recoverable from the server, only resettable, so keep that entry current. On a fresh node the script generates a password and prints it once, which must then be stored there and distributed securely. See docs/platypus-demo-tenant.md.
